~Grab Ledge~.Requirement: Only for Heroes and Epic monsters.
~Grab Ledge~.Effect:
Use when you would fall off a ledge.
Stop and hold onto the ledge.
You become Single-Stunned.
~Grab Ledge~.Upgrade:
If you were Slammed, take Damage equal to the remaining Slam meters.
Epic monsters can Grab Ledge.
~Grab Ledge~.Name: ~Grab Ledge~
~Grab Ledge~.Notes: A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

~Improvised Attack~.Effect: Attack with an object or body part for {Value} (Slash, Smash or Pierce Damage, depending on the object).
~Improvised Attack~.Notes:
Body parts are considered weapons.
Monsters' Improvised Attacks take a 1 {A}Action Point and deal 1d4 Damage.
~Improvised Attack~.Name: ~Improvised Attack~

~Push~.Effect: Slam a non-Epic, max medium-sized Unit 1 meter in any direction you choose.
~Push~.Name: ~Push~
